text:
alex: Vendor update: APAC A100 rack shipment slipping into next-week window. We need to decide fallback for Wed demo. @maria any quota wiggle?

maria: We have 12 preemptible GPUs in apac-edge. Demo path needs 20 reserved. Can do a smaller run (10 reserved) but not full.

jun: Which terraform changes are waiting on the SKU/quota? I can split up the PRs to avoid a big state lock.

alex: PR 482 (gpu-pools) contains apac SKU mapping + reserved pool create, blocked until quota or vendor ships. PR 491 (demo-canary) expects pool to exist.

sam: Quick option: borrow 6 GPUs from eu-west for the demo. Cross-region adds ~60ms cold-start per pod; fine for walkthrough but will skew perf slides.

procurement-bot: Invoice 98721 updated: payment terms changed, ETA subject to amended invoice. Ticket PROC-1123 opened. Contact vendor-ops@vendor.example for amendment.

maria: Opening cloud quota case now (Q-23844). If approved before 08:30 PST Tue we merge and apply. If not, fallback to eu-west borrow + reduced demo. Link: https://console.cloud/projects/redwood/quotas

ops-bot: Fallback routing scheduled. Will attempt region swap at 09:00 PST Tue and run smoke tests; results posted here.

jun: To avoid TF state locks I recommend splitting the pool resource. Example patch:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "apac_demo_meta" {
  count = var.create_apac ? 1 : 0
  sku   = var.apac_sku
}

resource "redwood_gpu_pool" "apac_demo_capacity" {
  depends_on = [redwood_gpu_pool.apac_demo_meta]
  reserved_gpus = var.apac_reserved
}
```
Apply the meta resource first, then capacity. Minimizes lock window.

sam: Another low-risk plan: spin up scaled demo (reserved_gpus=10) and document latency caveat in the intro slide. Less ideal but quick.

maria: Vendor replies they can do a partial rack ship tomorrow if we accept invoice amendment. Procurement is on it.

alex: If procurement confirms amendment, we merge PR 482 and apply immediately. Otherwise run reduced demo + eu-west borrow. Jun, keep the split-PR ready to land quickly. Sam, please draft a 2-line callout for the deck about reduced config and expected latency delta.

sam: Will add a one-liner and a short perf note.

vendor-ops: We can prepare partial shipment tomorrow AM if paperwork signed today. Sending draft amendment now.

procurement-bot: Amendment received, logged PROC-1123-AMD. Finance to review; ETA 4-6 hours.

alex: Great. Keep this thread updated with procurement decision and ops smoke-test results.

ops-bot: Smoke test scheduled for Tue 09:10 PST (post results here).
